scope: login-setup.sh and qa.py first-login probe (autologin keys)
correction: SDDM and GLib strip whitespace around '=' and around a section name, but login-setup.sh and login_autologin matched only the exact text 'User=' and an exact section header, so an active `User = other` in /etc/sddm.conf, a spaced drop-in key or a spaced GDM `AutomaticLogin = snowqa` was read wrongly. Both sides now parse a section header with surrounding whitespace stripped and each active line as key, '=', value with whitespace stripped (keys case-sensitive), and the GDM check reads [daemon] only.
